:::{#def-prediction-rmse}
#### Root mean squared error of predictions

The **sample root mean squared error (sRMSE)** of predictions,
also called their **root mean squared error**,
$\dsn{\fitted}$
of observed outcomes $\dsn{\outvar}$
is the square root of their [sMSE](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-mse):

$$
\rmselr{\fitted} \eqdef \sqrt{\mselr{\fitted}}.
$$ {#eq-prediction-rmse}

:::
